# ibee_bucket_cors (Resource)

The CORS rules of a bucket. Create and update replace every rule of the section (PUT); destroy deletes the section (DELETE). Import using the bucket name.

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py; edit schema descriptions in Go. -->

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ibee_bucket_cors" "assets" {
  bucket_name = "my-assets"
  rules = [{
    allowed_origins = ["https://app.example.com"]
    allowed_methods = ["GET", "HEAD"]
    max_age_seconds = 3600
  }]
}
```
